decisions.statement: Every unit of a stack an actionable rule takes reaches the plan.
A rule asking for no errand puts nothing in the plan.
A stock rule gives each character its target and no more.
No character is sent two copies of one recipe in a plan.
A character owed a retrieval waits for the character depositing that item.
A session freeing no venue is skipped rather than repeated.
Planning gives up after a hundred rounds.

definition: the whole errand list the rules come to, ordered by who does what next
